title: Conclusion and Orders
summary: This section concludes with the final judgments, declaring the primary judge's path of reasoning flawed and setting forth the orders for the parties involved regarding the next steps.
content: The Court, allowing the appeal, held: (i) The primary Judge erred in finding that the common intention of the parties on the date of execution of the Works Contract was that Seymour should have 30 days from the end of the relevant month in which to pay Ostwald, rather than an earlier date specified in the Works Contract.
